title: Skyward — Constellation Compass
description: Look around a living star dome, wheel the sky by hour and latitude, and draw your own constellations across it.
concept: A planetarium-style sky viewer rendered with hand-rolled 3D projection math: drag to look around a dome of ~400 seeded stars, tune the hour and latitude sliders to watch the sky visibly wheel around a tilted axis, then switch to Draw Mode and tap stars to connect them into your own named constellations that stay attached to the sky as it turns.
features: Look-around sky dome with inertial drag rotation plus pinch/wheel zoom
Draw-mode constellation builder — tap stars to link, name, and color your own constellations
Hour & latitude sliders that visibly wheel the sky around a tilted axis, with an auto-drift toggle
5 sky palettes and a live star-density slider
Save named skies to a localStorage gallery, export the current view as PNG, or share a link that recreates your exact sky
tech: Hand-rolled 3D perspective projection (spherical camera + axis rotations)
Pointer Events (drag look, pinch zoom, tap-to-select)

interaction.mouse: drag to look around the dome, click a star in Draw Mode to link it, scroll wheel to zoom
interaction.click: toggle Look/Draw mode, adjust sliders and palette, use the save/export controls
interaction.touch: drag to look around, pinch to zoom, tap a star in Draw Mode to link it
